name: q-core
description: The owner's life skills (statement and document intake, briefs, reminders, email triage, financial evals) and the q-core MCP connection, kept current automatically.

server_url.title: q-core URL
server_url.description: The Tailscale Serve origin, e.g. https://q-core.tail1234.ts.net (http://127.0.0.1:8420 on the server itself). No trailing slash.

api_token.title: q-core token
api_token.description: This machine's full-scope token from /ui/tokens or `python -m api.tokens create`. Claude Code keeps it in secure storage: the system keychain on macOS, its private credentials file on Linux; never settings.json.

server_ssh.title: Server SSH target
server_ssh.description: OpenSSH destination of the q-core server, e.g. owner@q-core. Leave unset on the server itself.

server_checkout.title: Server q-core checkout
server_checkout.description: Path of the q-core checkout on the server, used for backups and intake.

intake_dir.title: Local intake folder
intake_dir.description: Where statement folders are dropped on this machine before a push to the server, e.g. ~/Q/intake.
